description: This file contains definitions and configurations for building kernel modules related to FireWire support in the Linux kernel, including support for FireWire core, networking over FireWire, OHCI controllers, and SBP-2 devices. It primarily uses the syntax for defining kernel packages and their dependencies, file paths, and descriptions.

methods.name: KernelPackage/firewire
methods.description: Defines the FireWire kernel package with menu, title, dependencies, configuration, and associated files.

methods.name: KernelPackage/firewire-net
methods.description: Defines the support for IP networking over FireWire, including dependencies and autoload rules.

methods.name: KernelPackage/firewire-ohci
methods.description: Defines support for OHCI-1394 controllers with specific configuration options and associated files.

methods.name: KernelPackage/firewire-sbp2
methods.description: Defines support for SBP-2 devices over FireWire, with dependencies, configuration, and files.
